title: Japanese-style Bounty Bowl
description: A brown rice bowl with cucumber, spinach, carrot ribbons, edamame and sugarsnap peas, dressed with a miso ginger dressing and toasted sesame seeds.
ingredients: 1 quantity Miso Ginger salad dressing (see p.210)
2 spring onions, trimmed and finely sliced
steps: Cook rice per package instructions; drain through a sieve; run under cold water; drain fully.
Divide rice between 2 bowls; arrange cucumber, spinach, carrot ribbons, edamame, sugarsnaps and radishes on top.
Dry-fry sesame seeds until starting to turn golden.
Drizzle dressing over; sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and spring onions.
notes: Use a Y-shaped peeler to ribbon the carrot.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
